description: This Java class defines a superclass for all XML element models in the Mini-language framework, providing methods for handling element metadata, artifact information, and logging.

classes.name: MiniLangElement
classes.description: Superclass for all Mini-language XML element models, providing common properties and methods for processing XML elements in the framework.

methods.name: MiniLangElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MiniLangElement with an XML element and a reference to the containing SimpleMethod.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Method intended to update artifact information context; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the source code line number associated with this element, or 'unknown' if none.

methods.name: getSimpleMethod
methods.description: Returns the SimpleMethod object containing this element.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the tag name of the XML element.

methods.name: outputTraceMessage
methods.description: Logs a trace message with details about the current element and provided messages.
